Subject: Supplier onboarding: GST/VAT details & portal credentials

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to start Redwood's supplier onboarding — please find attached our basic registration template so your team can see our legal name and tax IDs. A few items we need clarified to avoid delays once we submit invoices:

- Which VAT treatment should we use for Redwood (reverse-charge or Redwood-charged VAT)?
- Do you require invoices in a specific XML e-invoice schema, or will a PDF invoice suffice for first POs?
- Who should be the portal administrator for e-invoice delivery at Redwood? We can provision automated SFTP or push XML to your portal if you share credentials.
- Any PO number formatting rules we should follow to ensure automatic matching in your payables system?

I've attached: Vendor_Registration_Template.pdf (fillable).

If you can point me to the procurement contact and the desired cutover date for the first PO, we'll prioritize the fields you need.

Best,
Ana Ruiz
Operations Lead
Global Paper Co
Attachments: Vendor_Registration_Template.pdf (PDF, 46KB)
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana@globalpaper.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: GST/VAT details & portal credentials

Hi Ana — welcome, and thanks for sending over the template. A few quick answers and next steps from procurement:

- VAT treatment: For EU vendors supplying services/products to Redwood's EU entity, we generally require invoices without local VAT and with the reverse-charge annotation where applicable. Finance will confirm by country after they validate VAT number.
- Invoice format: We support both PDF invoices and our XML e-invoice schema (preferred for automated PO matching). I'll attach the onboarding checklist with the XML schema link so your billing team can validate files.
- Portal options: We support SFTP push, API upload, or vendor-initiated portal upload. Please tell us which you prefer — if SFTP, share the endpoint and contact; if you prefer push to our portal, we'll create an API key or user for you.
- PO formatting: PO numbers should start with RDW- and include the 6-digit PO (e.g., RDW-000123). We'll add the requirement to the onboarding form.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx and link to our e-invoice XSD.

Proposed cutover plan (high level):
1) Receive completed onboarding form from you (this week)
2) Finance validates VAT ID and confirms reverse-charge applicability (1 business day)
3) Procurement creates initial PO and shares PO number (same day)
4) First invoice delivered and matched (day of PO)

Can you return the filled form and indicate who should be the portal admin? Once Ben signs off on the VAT handling we'll create the account.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx; https://drive.redwood.com/suppliers/schema/einvoice-v3.xsd
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 08:30:00 +0200
Subject: Fwd: Supplier onboarding: GST portal access, invoice XML & PO cutover

Forwarding Ana's note with suggested finance handling. Quick finance notes:

- For vendors in EU supplying to Redwood EU entity, mark accounts to indicate 'vendor-supplies-no-vat' when reverse-charge applies. That flag will suppress VAT validation and allow automated matching.
- Please ask vendor to put the text: "Reverse charge – Article 194(1) VAT Directive" in the invoice VAT notes section and include their VAT ID + our EU VAT ID (EU-REDWOOD-999).
- We'll provide a sample invoice XML extract (attached) that sets the VAT element to 0 and includes ReverseChargeIndicator = true for automated ingest.

Can Procurement confirm PO terms (Net 30 ok) and if we should require bank details on every invoice? I prefer bank details only once in the onboarding form to reduce PII in invoices.

Attaching: sample_invoice_redwood.xml (snippet)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample_invoice_redwood.xml
